meta.source: BB's Books directions canvas, board H3 · Title 36, italic Books (TitleItalic.dc.html)

tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: Screen background under the washes. Warm blush-white.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: The white top zone behind the title and count; text on the accent.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Titles, the hero count, book titles, selected chip text, the active tab icon. 17:1 on bg-base.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary ink: authors, eyebrows, captions, the word 'books', unselected chips, inactive tab icons. 9.8:1 on bg-base, 7.1:1 on the darkest wash.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Cobalt. The scan button, progress fill, eyebrow dot, active tab dot, profile icon and text on the tint. White text on it passes at 5.80:1. Never small text on the washes (3.9:1 on coral/pink).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Icons and text on an accent fill.

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Pale cobalt tint: chips and the profile button on pure white, where glass would look grey. Accent text on it passes at 5.03:1.

tokens.name: tint-border
tokens.usage: 1px border on the tint profile button.

tokens.name: outline
tokens.usage: 1px outline on unselected tint chips and other controls on pure white.

tokens.name: ledge-solid
tokens.usage: Shelf ledge fill when a shelf sits on pure white instead of the washes.

tokens.name: ledge-solid-border
tokens.usage: 1px top border of the solid ledge.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty part of a progress bar.

tokens.name: wash-coral
tokens.usage: Wash circle. Top-left of the screen at 80% opacity.

tokens.name: wash-pink
tokens.usage: Wash circle. Top-right and bottom-right at 75%.

tokens.name: wash-sky
tokens.usage: Wash circle. Mid-left and bottom-left at 85%.

tokens.name: glass-card
tokens.usage: Reading card fill. Backdrop blur 40px, saturate 1.8.

tokens.name: glass-chip-off
tokens.usage: Unselected glass chip fill. Backdrop blur 24px, saturate 1.6.

tokens.name: glass-ledge
tokens.usage: Glass shelf ledge under each row of covers. Backdrop blur 20px.

tokens.name: glass-tabbar
tokens.usage: Floating tab bar fill. Backdrop blur 40px, saturate 1.8.

styles.name: hero-count
styles.usage: The library count. One per screen, ink.

styles.name: app-title
styles.usage: App title. 'BB's' upright at 500; 'Books' uses app-title-italic.

styles.name: app-title-italic
styles.usage: The word 'Books' in the app title, italic 400.

styles.name: hero-unit
styles.usage: The word after the hero count, in ink-2, baseline-aligned 10px after the number.

styles.name: card-title
styles.usage: Book title in the reading card.

styles.name: cover-title
styles.usage: Title on a placeholder cover tile in the grid.

styles.name: cover-title-sm
styles.usage: Title on the small 54×80 cover inside the reading card.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Author line in the reading card and short body text, ink-2. Use 600–700.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Progress captions and small meta, ink-2.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase label with a 7px accent dot 6px before it, ink-2.

styles.name: cover-author
styles.usage: Uppercase author line at the foot of a cover tile.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Screen side gutters; title, count and content all start 20px in.

tokens.name: stack
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between the reading card, the chip row and the shelves.

tokens.name: card-pad
tokens.usage: Reading card padding, and the gap between its cover and text.

tokens.name: cover-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between columns in the 3-column book grid.

tokens.name: cover-lift
tokens.usage: The reading-card cover is lifted 12px above the card's top padding.

tokens.name: ledge-gap
tokens.usage: Space between the bottom of the covers and their ledge.

tokens.name: tabbar-inset
tokens.usage: Tab bar inset from the screen sides.

tokens.name: tabbar-bottom
tokens.usage: Tab bar inset from the bottom of the screen.

tokens.name: radius-cover
tokens.usage: Every book cover, large or small.

tokens.name: radius-tabbar
tokens.usage: The floating tab bar (half its 64px height).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, the profile button and the scan button.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Reading card: cobalt hairline, top highlight, bottom lowlight, soft blue lift.

tokens.name: shadow-chip-on
tokens.usage: Selected glass chip: top highlight and a soft blue shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-chip-off
tokens.usage: Unselected glass chip: top highlight only.

tokens.name: shadow-cover-sm
tokens.usage: The small cover inside the reading card (as drawn on H3).

blur.note: Backdrop blurs are paired with saturate(): 1.8 on the card and tab bar, 1.6 on unselected chips.

tokens.name: blur-wash
tokens.usage: filter: blur() on the wash circles.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur on the reading card and tab bar, with saturate 1.8.

tokens.name: blur-chip
tokens.usage: Backdrop blur on unselected chips, with saturate 1.6.

tokens.name: size-tab-target
tokens.usage: Tap target of each tab icon button.

tokens.name: size-icon
tokens.usage: Outline icons, stroke 1.9, round caps and joins.

tokens.name: size-dot-tab
tokens.usage: Accent dot under the active tab.
